SPAN.description: Span (SPAN). Defines a span line used for construction-stage/bridge analysis; the exact-span flag together with the SPAN_LIST lengths and the SPAN_BASE_ITEMS element/support assignments drive the geometry.

NAME.description: Span name (identifier label for this span).

bEXACTSPAN.description: Exact span option. When true, span lengths are given explicitly in SPAN_LIST.

DIRECTION.description: Inner direction of multiple girders. (-) Local y: 0, (+) Local y: 1, Both: 2, None: 3.

SECTTYPE.description: How elements are assigned to the span. By Selection: 0, By Number: 1.

SPAN_LIST.description: Span lengths (typically used when bEXACTSPAN is true). Ordered list of span segment lengths.

SPAN_BASE_ITEMS.description: Span base items: the elements that make up the span and their support locations. Each element key must exist in the model.

ELEM_KEY.description: Element number belonging to this span (must be an existing element).

SUPPORT.description: Support location at this element. None: 0, I-end: 1, J-end: 2.
